name: zapier-cowork
description: Unofficial local Cowork connection for read-only Zapier inspection.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect Zapier through a local MCP companion.
interface.longDescription: Platform-specific package for local Claude Cowork. Reuses the same OS user's saved Zapier login and requires account confirmation before inspection.
interface.defaultPrompt: Show my connected Zapier account and wait for confirmation.
